title: Chainmail Collective
summary: Small colored rings linked into shapes that advertise themselves — one medium, endless designs, lanes for every kind of maker.

blocks.title: The shape is the ad
blocks.body: Small colored chainmail rings snap into hearts, crosses, letters, logos, and jewelry. A short clip of rings closing into a heart needs zero explanation. One simple medium. Endless designs. Content does the selling; people pick a lane.

blocks.title: Working name
blocks.body: "Chainmail Collective" is a placeholder until something better sticks. Idea credit: Chris Stubbs (Sep 24, 2026). This series is the thin front door — drill pages hold the detail.

blocks.heading: Big idea in one breath
blocks.body: Link colored rings into shapes people already want. Founders prove it by hand first, then teach members. AI can help with mockups and captions later — it is never required. Everyone chooses how deep to go: buy a piece, order bulk, build from a kit, assemble for pay, design for royalty, or share and earn affiliate commission on real sales.

columns.name: One medium
columns.detail: Jump rings, pliers, color, and patience. The skill transfers across every product line.

columns.name: Endless designs
columns.detail: Hearts, letters, club logos, wall pieces, kits, pattern files, gift lines — same rings, new shapes.
